description: Check the user's Obsidian vault: where it is, how many notes, and exactly what AI may do with it (private / read-only / writable). A vault is just a folder of markdown notes (Dropbox/Drive-synced folders work).

vault_path.description: Vault folder; defaults to the folder chosen in UnClick's Obsidian vault settings, else OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH, else C:\UnClick\md_vault

name: obsidian_vault_status
